[[Fiery Crest]]s are a portion of [[Drake (NPC)|Fire Drake]]'s skin.

==Acquisition==
* [[Guild Wars Prophecies|Prophecies]]
** [[Ring of Fire Islands]]
*** [[Drake (NPC)|Drake]]


''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Fiery Crest#Drop research|here]].''
===Farming===
{{section-stub|Improve Walkthrough}}
 
====[[Perdition Rock]]====
About 20 Drakes can be found on the northeastern corner of the island. Bringing heroes to escort the player through the many hydras and flesh golems and then placing them outside of compass range is a good idea if running solo. 

===[[Ring of Fire]]===
3 groups of 3 Drakes each can be found just past the first Mursaat Tower. Be wary that one of the groups patrol into the volcano just northeast of the spot, and that entering that volcano will cause an [[Ettin]] group with a boss to move south through it. 

6 [[Nightmare (Ring of Fire Islands)|Nightmare]]s can also be found in that same section of the missions, 2 just west of the mission starting point and another 4 near the drakes, making this a good spot to farm both Fiery Crests and [[Smoking Remains]]. 

==Notes==
* There are no known permanent collectors of Fiery Crests at this time.
* This item is required by [[Imperial Chef Yan]] for his appetizers at the annual [[Canthan New Year]] festival.
